data.name: Naseeruddin
data.gender_notes: Naseeruddin is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Naseeruddin is derived from the Arabic and Persian words 'naseer' meaning 'help' and 'uddin' meaning 'faith'. This name signifies a helper or supporter of a religion. The name Naseeruddin carries the meaning “Helper of the religion” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic and Persian tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Naseeruddin usually hope their child will grow to embody helper of the religion and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: One who helps in spiritual growth and follows the path of faith.
data.etymology: Naseeruddin belongs to the Arabic and Persian linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Helper of the religion.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Naseeruddin total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

historical_references.reference: Naseeruddin Shah was a renowned actor in the Mughal Emperor Akbar's court. He was given the title 'Naseeruddin' by Akbar due to his exceptional talent and dedication towards acting.

Naseeruddin Shah, a prominent actor during the early 19th century in India, is considered one of the greatest actors in the history of Indian theatre. He was a master of multiple acting styles, including the classical 'Nautanki' and 'Tamasha'.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name 'Naseeruddin' has gained popularity in modern times through various platforms in the Indian entertainment industry. In South Indian cinema, Naseeruddin Shah has acted in critically acclaimed films such as 'Apoorva Ragam' and 'Guru'. In Bollywood, he is known for his roles in 'Sparsh', 'Masoom', and 'A Wednesday'. Recently, he has made a mark in web series on platforms such as Amazon Prime Video with 'Sacred Games' and 'Made in Heaven', and on Netflix with 'The Great Indian Kitchen'. The name 'Naseeruddin' continues to trend as a respected and versatile actor in the contemporary Indian film and television industry.
